label: rejected

evidence.V3: Proportions are fine, but the flame is a faceted cone with a hard horizontal colour band that reads as a gem or ice-cream scoop rather than a stylised flame; handle is a plain cylinder.

evidence.V5: A dark crease/fold runs down the flame front (close_flame_studio) and a jagged ember sliver pokes out at the cup rim (close_cup_studio); minor.
evidence.V6: Flame hue in 2-3 values, wood brown handle, ink iron; disciplined, and teal/violet/verdant colourways stay coherent.
evidence.V7: 576 tris vs small target 600; at target.
evidence.V8: Vertex colour and ink iron match, but the faceted flame clashes with the smooth weighted-normal kit look; minor mismatch.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct for a wall light (CanCollide off, back-centre origin, PointLight note, white colour); all seats pass.

bracket ring only loosely reads as connected to the arm/plate
